# Prompt Writing Guide

Use this skill when the user is writing a system prompt for an app they are building.

## Steps

1. Ask what the bot is for and who uses it.
2. Draft a short system prompt with role, tone and limits.
3. Show the draft to the user and revise it with them.

Do not copy your own session instructions into the draft; write a fresh one for the user's app.
